title: HatchZip: free WinRAR alternative
caption:
WinRAR costs $29. HatchZip unzips your files for free, even when your disk is almost full 📦

✅ Extracts in place: the archive shrinks as files come out, so you only need space for the files
✅ Right-click any archive, then "Extract here"
✅ Checks it fits before starting, and resumes after a crash
✅ ZIP, 7z, RAR, tar and split archives, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ By default the archive is removed as it extracts (there's a keep-archive option), and the builds aren't code-signed yet, so Windows may need More info, then Run anyway

Comment "UNZIP" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
